summary.headline: M&B Engineering Q2 FY27 revenue rose 25.4% YoY to INR385 crores and PAT rose 32.8% to INR29 crores; order book stands at INR1,109 crores.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations grew about 25% YoY to INR385 crores in Q2 FY27, the company's highest-ever quarter, with EBITDA up to INR43 crores and PAT up to INR29 crores. Gross margin for H1 was about 32%, down 1.5-2% due to steel price variation, though management said PAT was protected by volume and domestic-export mix. Phenix Sanand PEB capacity was expanded by 20,000 tons, with a further structural and Cheyyar expansion underway. Management announced a data center order and a high-rise order, both received after Q2 and excluded from the INR1,109 crore order book; freight costs are easing but remain above costing assumptions.

financial_highlights.value: INR43 crores; EBITDA margin about 10.6% per analyst question, not disputed by management

segments.name: Phenix (PEB and structural steel)
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue INR298 crores (77% of total), up 22% YoY. Order book INR874 crores (79%), including export orders of INR272 crores.

segments.name: Proflex (roofing and cladding)
segments.commentary: Q2 revenue INR87 crores (23% of total), up 37% YoY. Order book INR235 crores (21%). Cheyyar utilisation 55-60%; Proflex roofing utilisation about 99% per analyst, with volume up about 30%.

guidance_outlook: Revenue growth of over 25% guided for FY27, despite volatile conditions.
More than 20% CAGR targeted over the next 3-4 years, with progressive profitability improvement.
Margins expected to be better in H2 FY27 than H1 as freight eases and older orders complete; management said freight is still above original costing assumptions.
Data center order revenue to start hitting the top line toward end-Q3 FY27, with the major part in Q4 FY27.
Management indicated the UK market entry is targeted for FY28, and the West Coast US market will be served from Cheyyar from next fiscal.
capex_capacity: Sanand PEB Phase 1 brownfield expansion commenced commercial production on 26 October 2026, adding 20,000 tpa; Sanand PEB capacity is now 92,000 tpa and total PEB capacity is 124,000 tpa (Sanand plus Cheyyar).
Sanand structural steel expansion of 10,000 tpa is due on stream by Q1 FY28, taking structural capacity to 22,000 tpa.
Cheyyar brownfield expansion of 20,000 tpa has started and is due in Q3 FY28; combined PEB and structural capacity to reach 154,000 tpa by Q3 FY28.
Q2 capex INR43 crores; H1 FY27 capex INR70 crores.
Proflex is evaluating a specialised wide-span seam machine; decision expected within the current quarter. Three additional mobile units were commissioned over the last three quarters.
demand_pricing: Domestic inquiries at Phenix exceed 2.5 lakh tons; North American export inquiries exceed 40,000-50,000 tons; Canada inquiries have revived.
Management is fully booked for the current fiscal and part of the next; H2 FY27 export dispatches expected to rise sharply.
Export order of INR212 crores (won last year): over 50% dispatched but only about one-third of revenue recognised (about 1,800 tons).
Freight per container has fallen from about $12,000 peak to about $7,000-8,000 but remains above costing; customers are sharing part of the freight cost.
New orders are being priced after the Q2 steel price rise; management expects some steel price softening and some pricing correction.
Export duty into the US is 25% with no immediate reduction expected.
Proflex has more than 20 lakh sq m of inquiries and a railway backlog of over 3 lakh sq m; Q2 railway order booking about 80,000 sq m.

qa_highlights.question: Are the data center and high-rise orders included in the INR1,109 crore order book, and how large are they?
qa_highlights.answer: Not included, as both were received after Q2. Management said both are significant, with the data center order from a hyperscaler and the high-rise order of similar quantum; details to be disclosed in the Q3 results.

qa_highlights.question: Will margins on new orders differ from current margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said margins should be similar, as the processes and inputs match the existing heavy industrial PEB work; only the end use differs. Management also said it would try to improve margins beyond the current level.

qa_highlights.question: Why did gross margin fall 1.5-2%?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said H1 gross margin is about 32%, impacted by steel price variation, but PAT was protected by volume and domestic-export mix. Management expects some steel price softening.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Cheyyar utilisation and what is the status of the INR212 crore export order?
qa_highlights.answer: Cheyyar utilisation was 55-60% in Q2. More than 50% of the export order has been dispatched, about one-third of revenue recognised, and the balance is expected in H2 FY27.

qa_highlights.question: Is there capacity expansion planned for the Proflex roofing business?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is assessing a wide-span seam machine and will decide within the quarter. Roofing order book and pipeline are strong, and H2 utilisation is expected to stay similar.

qa_highlights.question: Why is incentive income only INR54 lakh against INR67 crore exports?
qa_highlights.answer: Incentives are recognised on dispatch, not billing. Some Q2 billed exports were dispatched earlier, so the incentive was booked in prior quarters; incentives will be higher in H2.

risks_watch: Freight and steel price volatility, linked to the Middle East situation, could keep Q2 margin pressure in place if easing stalls.
Export conversion has been slower for 5-6 months; the company expects faster inquiry-to-order closures, but this is not yet confirmed.
Data center order size, margin and follow-on phases are not yet quantified; management will update in Q3 results.
Cheyyar utilisation of 55-60% and the export order revenue timing (H2 FY27) are key execution checks.
IPO proceeds: INR155.27 crores of INR259.32 crores (60%) used as of 30 September 2026.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth, order momentum and the new data center and high-rise wins, but cautious on margins and export timing, citing freight, steel prices and the US tariff environment. Several answers were deferred to the Q3 call, notably data center order size and margin.
key_quotes: M&B has achieved its highest ever quarterly and half-yearly revenue during Q2 of FY27 and H1 of FY27 respectively.
domestic gives you volume and international business gives you margins.
we are fully booked for the current fiscal and also part of the next year.

growth.why: Management reiterated over 25% FY27 revenue growth and >20% CAGR over 3-4 years, backed by a 20,000 tpa Sanand PEB expansion now commissioned, a 10,000 tpa structural line due Q1 FY28, Cheyyar expansion due Q3 FY28, and an INR1,109 crore order book (plus Q2 inflows of INR441 crore), though specific timing and order-to-revenue conversion are only partly quantified.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: H1 gross margin about 32%, down 1.5-2% on steel price variation; management expects H2 margins better as freight eases (now $7,000-8,000/container vs $12,000 peak) and new orders are priced after the Q2 steel rise, but freight remains above costing and EBITDA margin is about 10.6%.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Sanand PEB 20,000 tpa already commissioned on 26 Oct 2026; Sanand structural 10,000 tpa due Q1 FY28 and Cheyyar 20,000 tpa due Q3 FY28, taking combined capacity to 154,000 tpa; Cheyyar utilisation is only 55-60%.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Revenue growth of over 25% guided for FY27 with INR1,109 crore order book (Q2 inflows INR441 crore), management fully booked for current fiscal and part of next, and H2 export dispatches expected to rise sharply (INR212 crore export order only about one-third recognised).

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: H1 FY27 capex INR70 crores with Cheyyar and structural expansions already under way; Proflex wide-span seam machine decision due within the current quarter, but Cheyyar utilisation at 55-60% gives no near-term need for new plant.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management held FY27 revenue growth guidance at over 25% and gave no raise; H1 revenue growth was 24.1% and export conversion is slower than expected, so an upgrade is not signalled.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Freight still above costing, steel price volatility linked to the Middle East, and export order revenue timing (H2 FY27) are key execution checks; H1 EBITDA up only 12.1% vs revenue up 24.1%.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Data center order (hyperscaler) revenue to start toward end-Q3 FY27 with majority in Q4 FY27, a high-rise order of similar quantum, and UK market entry targeted for FY28; quantum not yet disclosed.

rows.label: Data center and high-rise orders outside INR1,109 crore book
rows.why: Both orders received after Q2 and excluded from the INR1,109 crore order book; data center revenue starts toward end-Q3 FY27 with the major part in Q4 FY27, though size is not quantified until Q3 results.

rows.label: UK market entry and West Coast US served from Cheyyar
rows.why: Management targets UK entry in FY28 and West Coast US from Cheyyar from next fiscal; North American export inquiries exceed 40,000-50,000 tons and export revenue H1 FY27 was INR95 crore (+68% YoY), though US export duty remains 25%.

rows.label: Steel price softening and pricing correction
rows.why: New orders priced after the Q2 steel rise and management expects some steel price softening and pricing correction, but this is not confirmed and freight remains above costing.
